src.title: The Secrets to Perfect Oreo Ice Cream

recipes.title: Perfect Oreo Protein Ice Cream (Soft-Chunk Oreos)

items.i: scoop cookies & cream whey protein (~30 g)
Oreos, dunked in milk 15–20 seconds then frozen, halved

steps: Put 1 Oreo, the milk and vanilla in a tall container. Mix the protein, erythritol, black cocoa, salt and xanthan gum, then blend them in slowly over 30 seconds and blend 90 seconds more.
Pour into a pint and freeze 24 hours.
Dunk Oreos in milk for 15–20 seconds, bag them and freeze alongside the pint (6–8 at a time if you make this often).
Run the pint under hot water 1 minute and spin on Sorbet (Lite Ice Cream is a close second).
Make a hole near the edge, not the center, add the frozen dunked Oreos (halved), cover and run Mix-in. Keep the Oreos frozen until this moment.
recipes.notes: Recipe from the video's narration (he says the black cocoa is what Oreo uses and that whey, not whey/casein, keeps it ice-cream-like). He doesn't give macros or how many Oreos go in the mix-in; 3 Oreos and the macros are estimates.
